title: Thursday after closing — green flecks
body: Personal note — Thursday after closing: wash off the green flecks left by the water-treatment trial crew. the rats left the shed, and I had not yet heard that the clinic stopped answering.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same green flecks while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
